description: Job boards, talent platforms and careers pages for the job-hunt skill. Tracks follow job-hunt/preferences.md: A = relocation with visa sponsorship, B = remote from Cuba, B→A = remote that can lead to relocation.

fields.type: relocation_board | job_board | talent_platform | staff_augmentation | direct_careers | reference
fields.cuba_eligibility: cuba-filter = the source has a Cuba-specific listing; unverified = check each posting for country restrictions before shortlisting
fields.notes: Why it is on the list and what to watch for
fields.destination: Track A only: the country or region the jobs are in

search_tips: Read each posting in full; a platform being listed here does not make every job eligible
US-based companies and platforms are often unable to hire or pay people in Cuba because of US sanctions; look for an explicit statement before shortlisting
Remote talent platforms that only hire in countries where they have an entity (e.g. 'Colombia, Mexico, Argentina') are not eligible from Cuba
Local boards (InfoJobs, Tecnoempleo, OCC, Computrabajo, SEEK…) mostly list jobs for people who already have work rights: shortlist only postings that say they sponsor visas or support relocation
For Track A, prefer postings that mention visa sponsorship, relocation package or dependants
Add new sources here only if they publish postings that can be read and linked; skip homepages that only market developers to clients
notes.excluded: Companies from Relocate.me and its handbook left out for deal-breakers: The Workshop, Betsson (gambling); Magic Square, BytePitch, Uphold (crypto/blockchain); Exness, XM, MetaQuotes, FxPro (forex trading). Left out for having no findable careers page: EXADS, Palta, Vivid Money.
